violations.text: The food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils were not sanitized. The required utensil surface temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit was not achieved during the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher as evidenced by the failure of the thermolabel (temperature indicator) affixed to the surface of a utensil to turn black. Establishment to use 3 bay sink to sanitize all dishes until unit is properly adjusted. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

Foods in the first section of grill cooler were observed held at 47-48 degrees Fahrenheit. Ambient of this side was observed at 52 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were assessed and time/temperature abused foods were voluntarily disposed of. First section of unit was taken out of service during time of inspection to hold foods that require refrigeration for food safety. Establishment to monitor other 3 sections of unit (other sections were in proper temperatures). Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026
Large tote of powdered soap was not marked with the common name of the chemical. Container was labelled during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

The cutting boards on the cookline are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 09/06/2026

-Fry side prep unit top rail was observed in poor repair. Digital readout was observed at 49 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit was observed with ice in top rail to keep foods cold. Repair ticket in prior to inspection. -First section of grill drawers was observed at an ambient of 52 degrees Fahrenheit. First section of grill drawers was taken out of service to hold foods that require refrigeration. Repair ticket was placed during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -lip of fry side top rail -sides of refrigeration equipment -shelf area of prep unit -bottom area of kitchen dish machine door New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

-The faucet centerset at the 3 bay sink at the bar was observed leaking when in use. -The waste valve at 2nd basin of 3 bay sink in kitchen was observed misaligned and leaking when in use. Systems to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The following have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris: -drains at 3 bay sink, food prep sink, and 3 bay sinks at bar and kitchen -ceiling vents above dressing station -floors under equipment The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
Grout from floor tiles was observed in poor repair (causing residue and moisture accumulation). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2027

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (tomato slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2025
The consumer advisory provided does not disclose all of the foods (burgers and some steak items) on the menu that are raw or undercooked. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/08/2023

The cutting boards on the prep units are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/28/2025

-The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. -The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine in the kitchen. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2025
